1.explanation: This script uses `chrome-launcher` to spawn a headless Chrome instance and then invokes Lighthouse programmatically on `https://treo.sh`. When Lighthouse processes the DevTools trace, the `FrameCommittedInBrowser` event only contains `processPseudoId` (no `processId`), so the trace‐processor cannot map to a renderer thread ID and throws the error. Running `node repro.js` with `npm install lighthouse chrome-launcher` will reproduce the failure.”
1.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse (v10.0.1) is run programmatically against https://treo.sh in Chrome (canary or other recent versions), the trace‐processor encounters a `FrameCommittedInBrowser` event whose `args.data` contains only `processPseudoId` (no `processId`). The helper `findMainFramePidTids` uses `evt.args.data.processId` to build `mainFramePids`, so it becomes [undefined]. On the next loop it looks for a matching CrRendererMain thread for pid undefined, finds no event, and throws “Unable to determine tid for renderer process.”
